title: Fourth moment of vector Fourier coefficients
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$, define its vector Fourier fourth moment to be $\sum_\gamma \widehat f(\gamma)^4$, where $\widehat f(\gamma)$ denotes the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$
